proposedOverrides.name: Dominion of Newfoundland
proposedOverrides.summary: Newfoundland’s dominion-era history included fishing households, financial crisis and expanding public services. Colonial viceroyalty, distinct from later republics. Created 1776; imported 1800 to 1815 range is map coverage. Revolutionary fragmentation began 1810; Montevideo royal rule ended 1814. Card flags that 1815 cannot imply uninterrupted rule. Decoded extent is only identity evidence, not a verification of effective control throughout claimed territory. The decoded polygon extends north only to about 21.92°S and therefore omits major northern parts of the historical administration, including Potosí. It must not be presented as the viceroyalty’s complete extent. No geometry correction is included.
